title: Structural Chirality from Inverse Semigroups to Twisted Groupoid $C^*$-Algebras
summary: We develop a structural theory of chirality for inverse semigroups and show how it propagates canonically to étale groupoids and twisted groupoid $C^*$-algebras. Starting from inverse semigroup data equipped with admissible twist information, we construct a canonical twisted universal groupoid in the sense of Paterson and introduce a mirror correspondence encoding intrinsic asymmetry.
